title: Gaza demonstration in Luxembourg City calling on Luxembourg and the EU to act
location: Boulevard Roosevelt to Place de Paris, Luxembourg City
scope: One march in Luxembourg City reported on Saturday; no other concurrent or linked locations established.
organizer: Collectifs pour la Palestine, as reported by RTL.

state_target.target: Luxembourg government and European Union, called on to take concrete measures concerning Gaza/Israel. The Luxembourg government is the domestic state target.
state_target.evidence: RTL article reports that participants called on Luxembourg and the EU to take concrete measures; participants demanded sanctions against Israel and an end to the siege/famine.

demands_original: Participants called for Luxembourg and the EU to take concrete measures, including sanctions against Israel and an end to the siege/famine in Gaza; the demand concerns foreign-policy choices by Luxembourg as well as EU action.
participants_original: RTL describes hundreds; nearly 300 according to organizers.
threshold_50_evidence: Yes: the body report describes hundreds and nearly 300 attendees per organizers, clearly above 50; the estimate is approximate and attributed, not an exact count.

start_date.summary: The article was published 3 August and reports the march took place Saturday; the Saturday immediately preceding publication was 2 August 2025.

end_date.summary: RTL reports one Saturday march; no end time is given. The event day is used as the action end date.

location.summary: RTL gives Boulevard Roosevelt to Place de Paris in Luxembourg City as the route.

scope.summary: One Luxembourg City march is described; no linked multi-city action is supported.
